name: Sheshadri Industries Limited
summary: Sheshadri Industries Limited is primarily involved in the production of textiles. Its diverse product range encompasses cotton, blended polyester, and polyester viscose, in addition to various blended yarns, ready-to-wear apparel, and specialized medical textiles. Founded by B. N. Agarwal on August 26, 2009, the company maintains its main office in Secunderabad, India.
